recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current specification has evolved past the interim Confluence/tooling-IG pointer while preserving the approved FHIR-32021 intent; do not add historical pointer prose unless a future work group decision asks for a migration-history note.
issue_request: FHIR-32021 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested a more flexible replacement for the single underspecified Must Support flag, with the final resolution asking the must-support section to point to the Must Support replacement proposal and a fhir-tools-ig extension as an interim experimentation path.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-32021 was found. The first substantive source application found was 1e1665b9352f33a691326fdf3079bc19865a8681, which added source/obligations.html and updated source/elementdefinition.html to describe mustSupport together with an obligation mechanism.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes show the original 2021 mustSupport-code plan was reopened and replaced on 2022-08-15 with the tooling-IG/proposal path. Later Published FHIR-40296 moved obligation to an extension, and the combined branch already contains f3476bb09517bfc2be70454704575278968aef6a correcting stale obligations-page wording to use the extension. Later Applied FHIR-50579 and FHIR-50580 clarified the same obligations page without reversing the FHIR-32021 direction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source says mustSupport itself does not define exact support semantics, requires profiles to clarify required support, points detailed expectations to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/obligation, and links the obligations page from ElementDefinition, Conformance, documentation, and hierarchy navigation.
